title: Green Armor
wikitext:
'''Protection:''' 30% of the damage

'''Green Armor''' ('''GA''') is one of three [[Armor|Armors]] found in the game. This will bring your Armor to 100.  It is also the weakest of the armors, in terms of how many damage points go through the armor and against your health.

It plays a vital role in [[DM4]] to prevent too easy spawn fragging, and in [[DM6]] to even the odds of a player with megahealth against a player with red armor.
